identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical based on the ABY-271 construct.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: [177Lu]Lu-ABY-271 is an investigational lutetium-177-labeled affibody designed to bind fibroblast activation protein alpha on cancer-associated fibroblasts and deliver beta radiation to the tumor microenvironment.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted binding of the ABY-271 affibody moiety to fibroblast activation protein alpha (FAP), followed by localized beta-particle irradiation from lutetium-177.
downstream_effects: Radiation-induced DNA damage in targeted tumor-associated stromal cells
Cross-fire irradiation of nearby tumor cells within the tumor microenvironment
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Designed to target FAP-expressing stromal elements in tumors; quantitative human selectivity metrics not established.

typical_use.histology: FAP-expressing malignancies / tumors with FAP-positive cancer-associated fibroblasts

data_notes.record_scope: Record reflects publicly identifiable information for the investigational radiopharmaceutical [177Lu]Lu-ABY-271. Human clinical efficacy, safety, and PK metrics were not established in the accessible literature/trial registries checked.
